packageRules.description: Group the Azure SDK packages together
ASP.NET Core and System packages ship with the runtime and must move together
Test packages move together so the runner and adapter stay compatible
The Roslyn/Razor compiler toolchain powers in-browser compilation and its pinned prerelease versions must move in lockstep (see #190); require dependency dashboard approval
Framework-versioned packages track the TFM in Directory.Build.props; majors belong to a TFM upgrade, so require dependency dashboard approval
MudBlazor floats at * so the playground always runs the latest release; nothing for Renovate to manage
Group GitHub Actions updates into a single PR
